note: Every third-party component the build fetches. `commit` is the truth (a git tag can be moved); `version` is the tag, kept for humans. check_dependencies.py verifies this record in both directions - the shape, and that the CMake pin each entry names actually carries that commit - and the SBOM/provenance generators read this file instead of hard-coding components. The upgrade policy is docs/dependencies.md.

dependencies.name: FreeRTOS-Kernel
dependencies.note: V11.1.0 is an annotated tag; the tag object is recorded because it is what `git ls-remote` returns, but the commit is what the build verifies. Fetched by tag and shallow for speed, then the resolved revision is checked against this commit at configure time.

dependencies.name: Zephyr
dependencies.note: Fetched by `west init --mr v4.4.0` rather than FetchContent, so the pin lives in this port's CMakeLists and the smoke job compares it against the revision west resolved. west.yml also accepts a SHA in `revision:`; the tag is kept because it is what a human recognises and the comparison makes it safe.

dependencies.name: ThreadX
dependencies.note: Eclipse ThreadX, fetched by tag and shallow like FreeRTOS, then verified against this commit at configure time. The tag is a hotfix release (.202602a) because the preceding one broke Cortex-M builds - a reason to keep the commit, not the tag, as the truth.
